On March 1st, 2023. Officers pulled over a man with a suspended license and no insurance for the vehicle in Eau Claire, WI. He claimed to be picking up his girlfriend from work, but he appeared nervous and couldn't answer. Officers ran a check on him and he had some open drug cases in the past which led to the officers suspecting him to have drugs in the car and because of the odour of W**d from the car. They brought out the K9 to sniff the vehicle and then did a search of the vehicle.
